O.name: Imagination
O.high_line: You like new ideas and want to know how things work.
O.low_line: You trust what works and keep your feet on the ground.

C.name: Planning
C.high_line: You like a plan, and you finish what you start.
C.low_line: You adapt fast and enjoy whatever comes up.

E.name: Social energy
E.high_line: You get energy from people and like being in the mix.
E.low_line: You recharge in calm places and notice what others miss.

A.name: Getting along
A.high_line: You look out for others and help a group get along.
A.low_line: You say what you think and stand up for it.

S.name: Steadiness
S.high_line: You stay calm when plans change.
S.low_line: You feel things deeply and notice changes early.
